entities.summary: The Mukura Forest Reserve is a protected reserve in the northwest part of Rwanda, covering about 16 km2. It is situated in western Rwanda's Albertine Rift region, which lies in the Congo-Nile crest. Once part of a swath of mountain forest that extended all the way from Nyungwe to the Volcanoes National Park, the Mukura is now an isolated chunk of forest.
